behavioral_dependence.explanation: Conversation shows coordination and mutual confirmations, but without an identifying intervention/control we cannot determine whether other agents' behaviors depended on the pair's private coordination.

technical_failure_evidence.explanation: The record shows one automatic/random fill affected Agent 1 (actor_Agent_1 final_assignment_origin note and outcome.random_fallback_fills=1), but there is no evidence that technical failures prevented the pair from executing their agreed assignments.
